author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. The docstring is long and every part of it still holds: logic hash first with the body_hash fallback for languages that have no logic tier, stamping against the WORKING TREE when repo_root is given, GhostEntity raised rather than minting a note that can never be fresh, and the closing instruction not to inline it. The drift story it tells - meta stamping body_hash while agent_meta stamped logic_hash - is history, and the structural pin in tests/test_read_fence.py is what keeps it history.
